'''Ickabel G'ont''' was a [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Not for Nothing" /> [[Bith]] [[musician]] who played the [[double jocimer]]<ref name="USW" /> as part of the [[band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], G'ont and the other members of the band played at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited trying to find a [[pilot]] to take them to the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" /> She eventually wrote a memoir about her [[time]] in the band, called ''[[The Lady Has a Jocimer: My Life as a Modal Node, A Memoir]]''.<ref name="Not for Nothing" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ickabel G'ont was portrayed by [[Penny McCarthy|Doug Beswick]].<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=ElyMaaAFLKU|text=The Star Wars Cantina PT. 2 | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #tomspinadesigns #starwarshistory|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions|date=2025-05-03}}</ref>
